spanish: Esta torá del que en él plaga de tsaráat, que no alcanzare su mano en su purificación.

findings.issue: תּוֹרַת is a common noun (construct), dumped untranslated as torá; common nouns stay Spanish.
צָרָ֑עַת is a common noun (absolute), dumped untranslated as tsaráat; common nouns stay Spanish.

notes: Demonstrative, relatives, בּוֹ, construct נֶגַע, negation, hiphil 3fs with יָד as subject, and בְּטָהֳרָתוֹ match.
